Due to a permanent communication blackout, no direct flight path exists between Station Alpha and Station Beta.  
Furthermore, due to overlapping frequency bands, exactly one of the following two flight corridors must be included in the inspection route: the corridor between Beta and Gamma, or the corridor between Gamma and Delta.  

The objective is to determine the shortest possible closed flight route that visits every station exactly once and returns to the origin.
